{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Functions print their result on stdout.

sum_to() {
  local n=$1 s=0 i
  for ((i = 1; i <= n; i++)); do
    s=$((s + i))
  done
  echo "$s"
}

max_of() {
  local m=$1 x
  shift
  for x in "$@"; do
    if ((x > m)); then
      m=$x
    fi
  done
  echo "$m"
}

search() {
  local x=$1
  shift
  local -a xs=("$@")
  local lo=0 hi=$((${#xs[@]} - 1)) mid
  while ((lo <= hi)); do
    mid=$(((lo + hi) / 2))
    if ((xs[mid] == x)); then
      echo "$mid"
      return
    elif ((xs[mid] < x)); then
      lo=$((mid + 1))
    else
      hi=$((mid - 1))
    fi
  done
  echo -1
}

reverse() {
  local s=$1 out="" i
  for ((i = ${#s} - 1; i >= 0; i--)); do
    out+=${s:i:1}
  done
  echo "$out"
}

is_palindrome() {
  local t=${1,,} r="" i
  for ((i = ${#t} - 1; i >= 0; i--)); do
    r+=${t:i:1}
  done
  if [[ $t == "$r" ]]; then echo true; else echo false; fi
}

gcd() {
  local a=$1 b=$2
  if ((b == 0)); then
    echo "$a"
  else
    gcd "$b" $((a % b))
  fi
}

count_vowels() {
  local t=${1,,}
  t=${t//[^aeiou]/}
  echo "${#t}"
}

fizzbuzz() {
  local n=$1
  if ((n % 15 == 0)); then
    echo FizzBuzz
  elif ((n % 3 == 0)); then
    echo Fizz
  elif ((n % 5 == 0)); then
    echo Buzz
  else
    echo "$n"
  fi
}

clamp() {
  local x=$1 lo=$2 hi=$3
  if ((x < lo)); then
    echo "$lo"
  elif ((x > hi)); then
    echo "$hi"
  else
    echo "$x"
  fi
}

average() {
  local s=0 x
  for x in "$@"; do
    s=$((s + x))
  done
  awk -v s="$s" -v n="$#" 'BEGIN { print s / n }'
}","path":"solution.sh","tag":"7ea598ac"}
